decision: Retain B Cooper-Black-Stencil at160 with Roboto support. C found usable initial and refined title faces but neither matched the studio tone as closely. C ties B; both are subjectively preferred over the unaided Roboto title fallback.
revision_reason: No additional revision after inspection; preserve successful B settings and supporting hierarchy.
counterargument: SF Pixelate could imply screenprinting or modular stamps to another viewer, and New York is less literal than stencil. The preference is contextual self-assessment, not an objective quality result.
score_observations: Memorable rounded stencil word suits community print exchange.
Tactile playful mass without distressed military effect.
Title dominates at both scales; date/place remain easily locatable.
Plain support balances the expressive title without competing.
carryover_candidates: Cooper-Black-Stencil first discovered and selected in B; exact same title face and160px size retained.
Roboto supporting faces from supplied baseline.
carryover_layout: B one-line title160 and unchanged information layout retained.
